The track also appeared on the band's fourth single, released by Black Mammoth Records and Warner Bros.  Records on 18 August 2014 as the lead single promoting "Royal Blood".  "Figure It Out" also appears on the soundtrack for the video game "Pro Evolution Soccer 2016".

The track later appeared as the third track on the band's debut extended play "Out of the Black", and as the second track on the band's eponymous debut studio album, "Royal Blood".
